question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Insert
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Insert"** means to put something into something else. (डालना)

 
 
• **Example: **She inserted the key into the lock to open the door.
 
 
 
• **"Remove"** refers to taking something away from a place or position. (हटाना)
 
 
• **Example: **Please remove your shoes before entering the house.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Insert'** is **'Remove'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inform** (सूचित करना): To give someone facts or information.

 
 
• **Example:** Please inform me if you are going to be late.
 
 
 
• **Select** (चुनना): To carefully choose something as being the best or most suitable.
 
 
• **Example: **She was selected for the position based on her qualifications.
 
 
 
• **Inject** (इंजेक्ट करना): To introduce a substance into a body using a syringe.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor injected the vaccine into the patient's arm.
